findings.finding: Bootstrap caps sit 5.8-29.4 mm from their BST pins; BST traces are 0.2 mm and up to 35.6 mm long (with vias), and the OUT side comes back by a second long route. A large HS gate-drive loop risks bootstrap UVP half-bridge dropouts (not flagged on FAULT) and puts a 28 V/600 kHz node on long traces.
findings.evidence: sims/amp/check_amp_layout.py (pad-to-pin C222 25.88, C223 13.63, C224 5.83, C225 10.43, C320 29.39, C321 9.56, C322 9.29, C323 15.44 mm); BST net copper A_BST1M 32.4, B_BST1M 35.6, B_BST2P 31.8 mm from core.kicad_pcb segments
findings.reference_design: SLASEN3B fig 53: BST caps at both row ends, ~1-2 mm from pins 43/44 and 23/24, other pad straight back to OUT; 11.1.4 'place the BST capacitors close ... keep PCB routing traces at minimum length'. TPA3220EVM same.
findings.fix: Re-place C222/C223 (C320/C321) at the pin-44 end and C224/C225 (C322/C323) at the pin-23 end, <= 2 mm from the BST pins; OUT pads to OUT pins 39/40, 35, 32, 27/28 with <= 5 mm, >= 0.4 mm stubs. Do it together with R3-AMP-2 (the PVDD caps there move).
findings.margin: Fails by 1.5-7x against a 4 mm bound

findings.finding: PVDD HF decoupling (1 uF 0805 + 100 nF) sits at the pin-row ends, 6.5-8.1 mm from PVDD pins 29-31/36-38, with nothing closer. The estimated edge spike is ~7.7 V on 29.4 V = 37.1 V vs 37 V abs max. The 0805 1 uF/50 V keeps ~40-60 % at 28 V.
findings.evidence: sims/amp/check_amp_layout.py (6.45-8.08 mm); sims/amp/pvdd_spike.py (3.3 nH loop, 7 A/3 ns assumed -> 37.1 V; TI-style 2 mm -> 33.2 V)
findings.reference_design: SLASEN3B fig 53 note T2: 1 uF X7R under the heatsink close to the PVDD pins on the top-layer PVDD trace, outputs on the bottom layer; 10.2.1.2.1: >= 50 V rating; TPA3220EVM 4 x 1 uF/100 V 1206.
findings.fix: Add 1 uF/100 V X7R 1206 (e.g. Samsung CL31B105KCHNNNE, LCSC id to confirm) + 100 nF/100 V 0603 per PVDD group <= 2 mm from pins 29-31 and 36-38, returning to GND pins 33/34, 41/42 / 25/26; if the top is full, on B.Cu directly under the groups with >= 2 vias per pad. Bench: PVDD pin 29 to GND 33 peak <= 35 V at 4 ohm full power.
findings.margin: -0.1 V to abs max (estimate; edge rate assumed)

findings.finding: PSPMAA0805-100M (10 uH +/-20 %, Isat 10 A at -30 %) keeps ~5.6 uH at the 10 A typ IOC against TI's 5 uH minimum; IOC has no max. Fine at 3.2-8 ohm.
findings.evidence: sims/amp/lc_bench.py; PROD Tech PSPMAA spec p11 (0805 series); SLASEN3B 7.3/7.5 IOC 10 A
findings.fix: None needed; optional higher-Isat 10 uH (1050 size) if a short-circuit bench test shows trouble.
findings.margin: 12 % over 5 uH at IOC typ; 4 ohm peak 7.63 A vs Isat 10 A (24 %); Irms 4.86 vs 6 A (19 %)

findings.finding: The 4.7 R + 1 nF networks on the speaker nodes are in parallel with 1 uF and damp neither the LC (open-load +28 dB at 73 kHz) nor HF ringing the way TI's 3R3 + 10 nF does.
findings.reference_design: SLASEN3B fig 50: per leg 1 uF + 1 nF + 3R3/10 nF; TPA3220EVM: 1 uF film, snubbers DNP
findings.fix: Snubber caps to 10 nF/50 V X7R 0603 (C57112) and R to 3.3 R 0603.

findings.finding: No switch-node snubber footprints; BD idle common-mode ripple 0.6 Vpp at 400 kHz on the speaker wires; an EMI-only risk.
findings.reference_design: TPA3118D2EVM (SLOU342A fig 3): 10 R 0805 + 330 pF C0G per OUT pre-filter, 3.3 R + 10 nF post-filter
findings.fix: DNP footprints 10 R 0805 + 330 pF C0G 0603 from each OUT to GND next to U8 pins 21/23/27/29.

findings.finding: On a lost PD contract PVDD is cut in hardware while SDZ/RESET is still high; at most a soft thump.
findings.reference_design: TI: shut the amp down before removing PVDD

findings.finding: Plus runs one channel per chip open-load, which is safe (pre-filter feedback) but adds AD idle loss plus unspecified inductor core loss at 1.53 App ripple.
findings.fix: Bench: inductor temperature after 1 h idle; HEAD mode if it is hot.

findings.finding: The ~500 ns OTW_CLIP clip pulses aren't reliably seen through the polled TCA9539; thermal OTW is.
TPA3220DDWR C2879306 LCSC/JLC stock 0; a pre-buy is planned (fab/prebuy.csv).
